limits: Moments condition on the complete-event subset and do not repair the refused unconditional 20-component vector.
Finite saved-state mixture uses M_C population normalization; serial MCMC states are not independent field replications.
One shared diagonal source SD covariance; age/PPE independence and conditional count/PPE independence are working assumptions.
Count covariance is the existing pooled-window multinomial conditional on age membership, not an age-independent native-aliquot law.
Static 3 ha circular response, literal five-taxon transfer, zero reservoir chronology assumption and existing source/model limits remain conditional.
Reported spreads are conditional standard deviations of a first-order mixture, not Monte Carlo standard errors or calibrated intervals.
